name: Limacina Open Season
source:
An Angel & its Charge bond over sinew at the end of the world.

Six vignettes of their lives as everything frays away from them.

[From [url=https://lightningwing92.itch.io/limacina-open-season]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
世界末日，一位天使和它守護的人因筋腱而親近。

六段生活剪影，記錄身邊的一切如何逐漸散落、遠離他們。

［摘自[url=https://lightningwing92.itch.io/limacina-open-season]itch.io[/url]］
